ms.promise:
・Officially opening of the hackathon registration on taptools.io.
・Setup of a registration system capable of handling expected volumes.
ms.criteria:
・Registration system functions smoothly with all necessary information captured.
・Meets projected registration numbers without system overloads.
ms.report:
The TapTools Hackathon registration was successfully opened and completed, with a total of 62 participants registered. The registration system operated smoothly, without issues.
As registration is now closed, supporting evidence—including screen recordings, screenshots, database records, and emails sent to participants—has been documented. These materials can be accessed here: Google Drive Link.

ms.promise:

ms.report:
We successfully executed a marketing campaign to drive awareness and participation in the TapTools Hackathon. Our efforts spanned multiple platforms, including Twitter (X), Medium, and LinkedIn, utilizing high-quality promotional materials such as graphics, videos, and articles.
All supporting materials, including campaign analytics, published content, and engagement data, can be found here: Google Drive Link.

ms.promise:
・Implementation of system modifications to allow free API access for hackathon participants.
・Provide information on our registration landing page regarding timeframe, rules, and overall objectives.
ms.criteria:
・All registered hackathon participants can access the API without encountering a paywall.
・System stability with no significant downtime or disruptions caused by the changes.
ms.report:
The hackathon has been successfully completed, judging has concluded, and the winners are awaiting the official announcement. We have successfully removed the paywall, granting registered hackathon participants free API access. 
The final project submission date was March 4th, with 14 submissions logged. As evidence, the logs of API access to various endpoints have been provided, organized by endpoint and date, demonstrating successful access by participants.
All supporting evidence is available here: Proof of Achievement - Milestone 3

ms.promise:
・Comprehensive review and judging of submitted projects.
・Selection of winners and distribution of prizes to 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place finishers:

1st place = 20,000 ADA
2nd place = 15,000 ADA
3rd place = 10,000 ADA
Total Cost: 45,000 ADA
・Final close-out report
・Final closeout video
ms.criteria:
Judging process is completed in accordance with the following established criteria:
・Technical Innovation (25%): Originality and creativity in solving a problem using the API.
・API Integration (20%): Effective and seamless use of the provided API’s features.
・Functionality (20%): The project works as intended with minimal bugs.
・User Experience (UX) (15%): Intuitive and user-friendly design and navigation.
・Impact (10%): Potential to make a significant impact on the target audience or community.
・Presentation (5%): Clear and organized demonstration of the project’s features and potential.
・Doc
ms.report:
The TapTools API Hackathon has successfully concluded with the review and evaluation of 14 total submissions. 
The top 3 winners were selected and have completed KYC verification and is awaiting prize distribution:
